summary: Consumes one unit from a paired counter pair: pre-decrements the counter reached through the pointer at this+0x30 (remaining count), then post-increments the counter reached through the pointer at this+0x20 and returns its previous value.

operations.description: Pre-decrement the DWORD counter that the pointer stored at this+0x30 points to (remaining-capacity counter).
Load the current-position counter pointer v1 = *(this+0x20) (pointer to a DWORD counter).
Post-increment the DWORD at *v1 (the counter pointed to by this+0x20) and return its previous value.

unresolved: Raw source increments the DWORD VALUE at the pointer stored in this+0x20, not the pointer itself; the streambuf put-pointer-advance reading in the existing analysis conflicts with that spelling.
Exact role of the two counters (remaining count vs. current position) and their owner object are unproven; legacy ABI names the type Unidentified_Logic_Pointer_Indirection_Counter_T.
